title: Remote Senior DevOps and Systems Engineer
description:
Job Description

About Us

Snappy Shopper is the UK's fastest‐growing quick commerce (Q‐commerce) platform powering rapid grocery delivery from local convenience stores. We enable independent retailers and major partners, including SPAR, Nisa, Premier, Co‐op and others, to digitally transform their business by offering same‐day and rapid delivery of food, drink and everyday essentials within as little as 30‐60 minutes. We're more than a delivery app, we're a technology partner for local high streets, providing tools for digital sales, marketing solutions, and integrations that help retailers compete with larger online players.

At Snappy Shopper, we're committed to innovation, retail empowerment and community impact, helping stores thrive digitally, offering exceptional local convenience to customers, and shaping the future of on‐demand retail in the UK.

Our location

We are a UK company with colleagues across the country and offices in Dundee and Edinburgh. This is a UK-based remote role, with occasional opportunities to connect with colleagues in person.

About the team

You'll join our Infrastructure team, working closely with Software Engineers and other technical teams to keep the systems behind Snappy secure, reliable and performing at their best.

We're looking for someone with strong, hands-on systems administration experience who has also developed modern cloud and DevOps capability.

You'll be equally comfortable getting under the hood of a Linux production environment as you are working with AWS, Terraform, automation and CI/CD.

About the role

As a Senior Linux Systems & DevOps Engineer, you'll take a hands-on responsibility for running, troubleshooting and improving the infrastructure our platform depends on.

This isn't a role focused solely on cloud provisioning and deployment pipelines. You'll work across Linux systems, web and application infrastructure, databases, networking, AWS and automation, and you'll be expected to investigate problems through the full technology stack when something isn't behaving as expected.

Day-to-day, you will:

  • Manage, monitor and improve our production AWS and Linux infrastructure.
  • Run and maintain the services our platform depends on, including nginx, Apache, Redis, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch and relational databases.
  • Maintain and improve our infrastructure as code, configuration management and CI/CD environment using Terraform, Ansible and Bitbucket Pipelines.
  • Manage our CDN and WAF layer across Akamai and Cloudflare.
  • Monitor platform health and performance, responding to alerts and identifying opportunities to improve resilience.
  • Take ownership of production incidents, troubleshooting across systems, networking, databases and infrastructure to identify root cause and restore service.
  • Automate repetitive operational work using Python and Bash.
  • Participate in our shared 24/7 on-call rota once fully onboarded.

To be successful, you'll have:

We're looking for someone with genuine systems administration depth alongside modern DevOps capability.

You'll bring solid experience in DevOps, Systems Administration or a similar infrastructure role, with strong hands-on Linux experience in business-critical production environments.

You'll be confident troubleshooting beyond the cloud or deployment layer, working across operating systems, networking, web infrastructure and databases to understand what's actually causing a problem.

You'll also have strong AWS and infrastructure-as-code experience, an automation-first mindset, and the ability to take ownership when production issues arise. You'll be comfortable working independently, making sound decisions under pressure and knowing when to involve others.

Experience across our wider technology stack, including nginx, Apache, Redis, MariaDB/RDS/Postgres, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Terraform and CDN/WAF technologies will be important, although we're equally interested in your underlying technical depth and ability to pick up the specifics of our environment.

You'll also need to be comfortable participating in a 24/7 on-call rota.

Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines, Ansible and monitoring tools such as Zabbix, CloudWatch, Pingdom or New Relic would be useful, as would working knowledge of PHP or Node.js and experience within PCI DSS or ISO 27001 environments.

Who you are

  • Community: You collaborate and share success with colleagues and partners.
  • Be Snappy: You work at pace and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Breaking Barriers: You find creative ways to solve problems and open new opportunities.
  • Craic on: You enjoy working with a range of stakeholders and bring positive energy to the role.

What's in it for you

Joining Snappy as a Senior DevOps and Systems Engineer means joining a collaborative engineering environment where your expertise genuinely influences how we build, deploy and scale our platform. You'll work on meaningful technical challenges, have the autonomy to improve the systems you own, and play a key role in delivering a reliable experience for retailers and customers across the UK. We offer a competitive salary, flexible remote working and ongoing opportunities for learning, development and career growth.

Applying

We want our recruitment process to give you (and us) a proper opportunity to understand whether the role is the right fit.

Following an initial application review, selected candidates will have a first conversation with our Engineering team to discuss your experience, the role and Snappy's technical environment.

Candidates progressing from there will be invited to a more in-depth technical interview, where we'll explore both your systems administration and DevOps experience in greater detail.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to inclusive recruitment.

Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we're only able to contact candidates who are selected to progress to the next stage.

title: Software Engineer (Full Stack Developer)
description:
Job Description

About Strathclyde Partnership for Transport


Strathclyde Partnership for Transport (SPT) is the largest of Scotland’s seven Regional Transport Partnerships, serving a population of more than 2.2 million people across 12 local authority areas in the West of Scotland.


SPT’s role is to bring together local authorities and key regional and national partners to plan and deliver an integrated, sustainable transport system that supports inclusive economic growth, tackles inequality, and improves quality of life. At the heart of this is a clear ambition: to deliver a world-class, low-carbon transport system that meets the needs of people and communities now and in the future.


SPT sits at the centre of regional transport planning, combining strategic insight, robust analysis, and practical delivery. The organisation plans and supports transport across all modes, working closely with councils, Transport Scotland, the Scottish Government, operators, and communities to shape how transport services evolve over time.


Alongside its strategic planning role, SPT delivers and supports a wide range of transport activity across the region. This includes investment in bus services, infrastructure and subway, management of major transport programmes, and the delivery of passenger-focused improvements that help keep communities connected.

SPT is now entering a period of significant transformation. Completion of the Subway Modernisation project, major programmes such as Bus Reform and Clyde Metro represent some of the most ambitious transport initiatives ever undertaken in the West of Scotland.


Together, they will reshape how public transport is planned, governed, and delivered, placing passengers, communities and long-term sustainability at the heart of decision-making.


This is an organisation with a strong public service ethos, a collaborative culture and a growing national profile. For professionals who want to work at scale, influence long-term outcomes and help deliver meaningful change, SPT offers a uniquely compelling environment.


You can read more at our SPT website by clicking the Apply button now.


About this role:

We value talent and recognise that great developers can come from various technology backgrounds. While our ideal candidate possesses expertise in PHP, Laravel, Vue.js, Linux Administration, and Containers, we also welcome applicants from other technology stacks.


We believe in providing opportunities for growth and learning, which is why we offer training programs to upskill successful candidates in our preferred technology stack. If you have a solid foundation in programming, a passion for problem-solving, and a willingness to learn, we would encourage you to apply.


SPT Digital projects are varied, encompassing many aspects, including the replacement of legacy systems, innovating solutions to replace manual processes, and delving into new solutions across the Partnership. This is an opportunity to make a difference to technology that directly and indirectly supports transport services in the west of Scotland.


The Software Engineer will develop and maintain high-quality web applications using PHP, Laravel, Vue.js, and other relevant technologies, collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement new features and enhancements. The Software Engineer will write clean, efficient, and maintainable code while adhering to coding standards and perform thorough testing and debugging to ensure the functionality and performance of applications.

They will also troubleshoot and resolve any issues related to Linux administration and containers and ensure application security and implement best practices to protect sensitive data. The Software Engineer will be required to stay up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies and continuously improve their skills.


About You

The successful candidate will have experience as a Full Stack Developer, with a strong focus on PHP, Laravel and Vue.js or other object-oriented programming languages. You will have an understanding of and implementation of SOLID principals, Linux administration, including server set up and maintenance. You will have knowledge of docker and orchestration tools and relational databases such as MySQL and proficiency in writing efficient SQL queries.


The successful candidate will have experience with front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS and JavaScript frameworks like Vue.JS as well as an understanding of code versioning tools, such a Git.

You will be able to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment and have excellent problem-solving, analytical skills, strong communication and interpersonal skills.


Full time hours will be 35 hours per week Monday to Friday. However, you may be required to undertake work outwith this norm to meet the responsibilities of the post.


Whilst you will be based at 131 St Vincent Street, Glasgow, SPT operate a hybrid working pattern which allows 40% home working (i.e. 2 days per week Monday to Friday).


Please note, this position falls into the low-risk category under the Alcohol and Drugs policy and therefore is subject to for-cause testing procedures.


Further details of the role and key responsibilities are set out in the job description.


What we can offer……

Working at SPT comes with many benefits you can look forward to:

  • 33 Days Annual and Public Holiday Entitlement then 41 days after 5 years’ service
  • Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme - SPT contribute a percentage of your annualised pay in line with the requirements of the Strathclyde Pension Fund
  • Group Life Assurance Cover
  • SPT actively encourages learning and development and are committed to ongoing learning and development to support career progression
  • Employee Travel Pass Scheme - a Subway Smartcard to travel on the Glasgow Subway for free plus an additional card for a member of your household
  • Salary Sacrifice Bus or Rail Season Ticket Scheme - subsidised at a maximum of £667 towards the cost
  • Cycle to Work Scheme, Childcare Vouchers, Employee Assistance Programme, Long Service Awards, Credit Union


How to Apply?

To apply, please select the ‘apply now’ button to complete an online application form.

Closing date for applications will be midnight on Sunday 4 October 2026

SPT is an Equal Opportunities company welcoming applications from a diverse background. If you’ve got the right skills for the job, we want to hear from you. SPT encourage applications from the right candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, belief or race.

SPT operates blind recruitment, which is the process of removing any and all identification details from candidate application forms. This includes identifiable personal details such a candidate’s name, gender, ethnicity and age. This information is not visible to our Hiring Managers. This practice is used to ensure fairness, attract diverse candidates and to remove unconscious bias from our recruitment process. By implementing this approach, SPT aims to create a level playing field to assess applicants solely based on their skills, qualifications and experience.


For applicants with special requirements, or if you have any questions, please email quoting the above reference.

title: Backend Engineer – AI Text-to-Speech Platform (Remote)
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.

Overview

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API
  • Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break
  • Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on
  • Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for
  • Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat
  • Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us
  • Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)
  • Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud
  • A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created
  • A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone
  • The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it
  • Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it
  • A preference for being corrected over being right
  • Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments
  • Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Krijg je voldoening van het meedenken met klanten en het vertalen van hun noden naar concrete oplossingen? En voel je je comfortabel in een rol met veel autonomie en verantwoordelijkheid? Dan is deze functie als Modern Workplace Engineer in Rumst iets voor jou.

Je komt terecht in een innovatief IT-bedrijf dat organisaties ondersteunt in hun digitale transformatie, met een sterke focus op moderne werkplekomgevingen en cloudoplossingen. Het bedrijf is actief in België en werkt voornamelijk met KMO’s samen, waarbij kwaliteit, flexibiliteit en klantgerichtheid centraal staan.

We zoeken iemand die vanaf de start mee de architectuur en standaardisatie bepaalt voor de manier waarop Microsoft 365-omgevingen worden opgezet, beheerd en schaalbaar gemaakt worden over meerdere (KMO) klanten heen binnen een MSP-context. Daarnaast wordt verwacht dat je actief meewerkt aan het operationeel en hands-on opleveren van projecten.

Als Modern Workplace Engineer maak je deel uit van het engineeringteam, dat verantwoordelijk is voor het oplossen van complexere problemen die niet door de servicedesk kunnen worden afgehandeld.

Verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Opzetten van IT-platformen vanaf nul

  • Moderne werkplekomgevingen uitrollen bij klanten

  • Optimaliseren en structureren van bestaande IT-processen

  • Analyseren de de noden van klanten en vertalen naar concrete oplossingen

  • Klanten adviseren, onder andere rond security en de inrichting van hun IT-omgeving

  • Klanten telefonisch te woord staan en ondersteuning bieden vanop afstand

Concreet:

  • Opzetten van Microsoft 365-omgevingen

  • Configureren van gebruikers en beveiliging

  • Automatisch configureren van laptops (via Intune/Autopilot)

  • Teams en SharePoint organiseren

  • Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma in IT of een gerelateerd vakgebied.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen en implementeren van moderne werkplekomgevingen, met een sterke kennis van Microsoft 365, Autopilot en Intune.

  • Kennis van Azure is een pluspunt.

  • Je beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden en denkt oplossingsgericht.

  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels en werkt graag samen in een dynamische omgeving.

title: Backend Engineer (Internship)
description:
About Klook

We are a leading pan-regional experiences platform in Asia Pacific, purpose built to digitalize experiences and make them accessible to every traveler.

Our mission is to build the digital infrastructure for the global experience economy — empowering merchants to share their passions and travelers to discover the heartbeat of each destination.

We operate a mobile-first, curated platform featuring diverse experiences across global destinations.

Do you share our belief in the wonders of travel? Global citizens ourselves, Klookers are not only curating memorable experiences for others but co-creating our world of joy within Klook.

We work hard and play hard, upkeeping our high-performing culture as we are guided daily by our 6 core values:

  • Customer First
  • Push Boundaries
  • Critical Thinking
  • Build for Scale
  • Less is More
  • Win as One

We never settle, and together, we believe in achieving greater heights and realizing endless possibilities ahead of us in the dynamic new era of travel. Care to be a part of this revolution? Join us!

Key Responsibilities
  • Under the guidance of a mentor, participate in requirements analysis and technical solution design for assigned product areas, and drive solutions through to implementation. Take ownership of module development, testing, deployment, and post-launch troubleshooting, with accountability for code quality and delivery outcomes.
  • Manage project tasks and priorities effectively, ensuring smooth delivery throughout the development lifecycle. Collaborate closely with Product, QA, Operations, and other cross-functional teams, proactively communicating progress, identifying and escalating risks, and ensuring high-quality, on-time delivery.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly in accordance with data security requirements and engineering standards. Independently validate the correctness, security, and reliability of AI-generated code, while continuously improving development efficiency and code quality.
Qualifications
  • Current students graduating in 2027 (Bachelor's degree or above). A minimum 3-month commitment from Dec 2026 to Feb 2027; extensions are welcome.
  • Pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related discipline is preferred. Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, including data structures and algorithms, operating systems, computer networks, and databases. Hands-on development experience in one or more mainstream programming languages, such as C++, Golang, Python, Java, JavaScript, or Objective-C.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools to complete software engineering tasks, with the ability to effectively break down complex tasks and independently evaluate and validate the quality of AI-generated code.
  • Strong learning agility and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a proactive mindset, strong sense of ownership, and willingness to take responsibility for deliverables.
  • Klook will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require sponsorship of a visa.

Klook is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented and passionate people of all backgrounds. We believe that a joyful workplace is an inclusive workplace, one where employees from all walks of life have an equal opportunity to thrive. We’re dedicated to creating a welcoming and supportive culture where everyone belongs.

Klook does not accept unsolicited resumes from any temporary staffing agency, placement service or professional recruiter (“Agency”). Klook will not be responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions or other payments related to such unsolicited resumes. An Agency must obtain advance written approval from Klook’s Talent Acquisition Team to submit resumes, and then only in conjunction with a valid fully-executed agreement for service and in response to a specific job opening for which the Agency has been requested to submit resumes for. Klook will not be responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions or other payments to any Agency that does not have such agreement in place or does not comply with the foregoing.

title: Java Full Stack Developer | Blue Dot Rec | Glasgow, UK
description:
Position Summary:

Blue Dot Rec is seeking an experienced, highly technical, and accomplished Java Full Stack Developer with 8+ years of enterprise software engineering and application development experience to join our client engagement team on a full-time contract basis for 5 days onsite work in Glasgow, UK. In this specialized full stack and enterprise development role, you will spearhead designing, developing, and scaling robust Java/Spring Boot backend services and modern frontend applications utilizing React or Angular. You will work closely with enterprise architects, software engineers, and financial stakeholders within the BFSI and investment banking sector to deliver high-performance, containerized cloud applications. Ideal candidates bring a robust academic degree in computer science or software engineering, deep practical mastery of Kubernetes, ECS, AKS, Docker, and immediate availability for onsite deployment in Glasgow.

Detailed Job Description:

As a Java Full Stack Developer at Blue Dot Rec in Glasgow, UK, you will take full ownership of end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC) activities, enterprise application architecture, RESTful API development, database optimization, and containerized deployments. Your day-to-day responsibilities encompass building scalable microservices with Java and Spring Boot, developing responsive user interfaces with React or Angular, writing complex SQL queries, and managing container orchestration platforms on Kubernetes, ECS, and AKS. You will collaborate proactively with cross-functional engineering squads, QA teams, and business analysts to troubleshoot production defects, perform rigorous code reviews, and ensure high system resilience. Working in a fast-paced investment banking technology environment in Glasgow, you will drive engineering excellence, cloud adoption, and software reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable enterprise Java and Spring Boot backend applications and microservices.
  • Build modern, responsive, and high-performance frontend web applications utilizing React or Angular frameworks.
  • Develop and consume robust RESTful APIs, integration endpoints, and secure database data access layers.
  • Write optimized SQL queries, stored procedures, and relational database schemas for high-throughput transactional systems.
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot containerized application deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes (K8s), ECS, and AKS.
  • Work across the complete software development lifecycle (SDLC) from architectural design to production release and support.
  • Collaborate proactively with enterprise architects, software engineers, QA teams, and business stakeholders in Glasgow.
  • Conduct rigorous code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and automated test-driven development (TDD).
  • Troubleshoot complex production incidents, perform root-cause analysis (RCA), and execute rapid performance optimizations.
  • Ensure strict adherence to enterprise security baselines, coding standards, and BFSI regulatory compliance frameworks.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum 8+ years of professional software engineering and enterprise application development experience.
  • Expert technical proficiency and operational mastery of Java and Spring Boot development frameworks.
    • <
  • Strong hands-on experience building modern web frontends using React or Angular.
  • Solid SQL and relational database design and optimization skills.
  • Proven operational mastery of containerization and orchestration platforms including Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, ECS, and AKS.
  • Strong understanding of cloud computing environments, microservices design patterns, and enterprise architecture.
  • Professional availability for full-time contract employment on a 5-days onsite schedule in Glasgow, UK (Application email: amir@bluedotrec.com).

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Professional certifications such as Oracle Certified Professional Java SE Developer, AWS Certified Developer, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
  • Prior working experience in BFSI, financial services, or tier-1 investment banking technology divisions.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipeline automation tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, ArgoCD) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform).
  • Advanced performance tuning experience for high-concurrency enterprise Java applications.
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and additional languages.

Salary & Contract Information:

  • Salary/Rate: Competitive market contract rate commensurate with experience
  • Deadline: Open until filled
  • Notice Period: Immediate to short notice preferred
  • Contract Duration: Contract / 5 Days Onsite (Glasgow, UK)

title: Data Engineer - Finance & Risk Insights
description:
Are you excited to apply your data engineering skills and make a real impact? As a Data Engineer at Van Lanschot Kempen, you will play a key role in transforming raw data into valuable insights that support critical business decisions. You will join our forward-thinking Data, Analytics & Quant Solutions (DAQS) department, working alongside a team of engineers, analysts and quants. Together, you will support a wide range of stakeholders, including Bankers, Regional Directors, Business Controllers, Risk Managers and senior management.

In this role, you will become part of the Finance & Risk Insights (FRI) team. FRI works with financial and risk data to enable the Finance, Risk and Control teams to deliver reliable management information that helps steer the bank.

Using advanced technologies such as Databricks and Microsoft Azure, you will design and optimize data pipelines and information products that drive meaningful improvements in our commercial, financial and risk management processes. You will have the freedom to experiment with the latest tools, share ideas and contribute to innovation across our platforms.

We believe the way organizations work with data is fundamentally changing. That is why we do more than build reports. We continuously explore new ways of making data accessible and actionable for stakeholders through interactive visualizations, data products and AI-driven solutions.

Your work will empower colleagues across the organization to make better‑informed decisions. Our multidisciplinary and agile environment encourages continuous learning, with opportunities for mentoring, hackathons and access to the latest data engineering training programs. Are you passionate about developing yourself as a data engineer, building solutions that matter and joining an open, curious team that is shaping the future of finance? If so, we would love to hear from you.

Your responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Delta Lake, Databricks DLT and workflows.

  • Enable stakeholders to access and leverage data through interactive insights, visualizations, data products and AI-driven applications.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, data providers and platform teams to optimize data‑driven products and solutions.

  • Present and advocate robust data‑driven solutions to decision‑makers.

  • Contribute to innovation by evaluating and applying new technologies, AI capabilities and modern ways of working where they add value.

  • You're energized by complex problems, enjoy getting to the root cause of issues, and like working with others to reach lasting solutions.

title: Software Development Engineer II (Java) - Identity
description:
The engineers in our team build the APIs that securely authenticate customers across all touchpoints with Tesco around the globe: online, over the phone, and in-store. You'll focus on making our experiences as streamlined for customers as possible, by exploring innovative authentication factors to dynamically assess the risk of each individual customer session. Your work will often be at the heart of new propositions across the Tesco Group. All of this happens in a world where scale and resilience are critical - serving over a billion API calls every week in only a handful of milliseconds each!

The stack: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Kubernetes, Azure, and Kafka

We are responsible for the software throughout the lifecycle; we maintain a DevOps culture, employing continuous integration and delivery, supporting our code through to production and beyond, as well as being firm believers in TDD.

  • Designing, building and maintaining high-performing mission-critical systems
  • Collaborating with product managers to translate customer and business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Producing test-driven features and demonstrating your familiarity with the TDD cycle.
  • Supporting production systems, resolving incidents, and performing root cause analysis.
  • Sharing knowledge with the wider engineering community.
  • Mentoring and supporting and helping junior engineers within the team.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one major programming language (Java preferred) and ecosystem to design, build and support production systems independently.
  • Hands-on experience of building and supporting production Java applications.
  • An understanding of the SOLID principles and how to apply them to create well-structured, maintainable software.
  • A DevOps mindset, with experience of supporting production systems, resolving incidents, and performing root cause analysis.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively within a cross-functional team

An understanding of identity and access management concepts, such as OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC), would be advantageous.

You might know us as a supermarket, technology company or even for our award-winning mobile network. Truth is, we're all of those things, and much more. Our colleagues work with one goal in mind, helping to make every day a little better for our customers, colleagues and communities all over the world. No two customers are the same, neither are our colleagues. At Tesco, we champion a balance that lets you thrive both in and out of work. Spend 60% of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely. Whether you're just kicking off your career, juggling passions, or navigating big life events, we're here to support you. We always welcome a conversation about flexible working, so talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. We're proud to be an accredited Disability Confident Leader, where everyone's welcome. That's why we commit to providing a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. And if you're interested in joining our team but don't tick every box, don't let that hold you back from applying. When you join us in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Stores Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.
